field_descriptions.evidence_level: Strength of evidence of the data used to formulate the guideline (enumerated).
field_descriptions.evidence_origin: Source of the data used to formulate the guidance, e.g. RCT, consensus opinion, etc.
field_descriptions.guideline_date: Date on which this guideline's recommendation was made.
field_descriptions.guideline_subject: The medical conditions, treatments, etc. that are the subject of the guideline.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
